Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">アナキンのライトセーバー</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.<ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値＞3のスカイウォーカーにフォースを消費せずに配備する。キャラクターがいる場所のフォース消耗に＋1。フォースを消費せずに起動する。キャラクターを目標とする。運命数を2枚引く。運命数の合計＞能力値なら、キャラクターに命中し、目標は没収値＝0となる。</span><ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">アナキン・スカイウォーカーが作ったライトセーバー。ルークに手渡すべく、オビーワンが保管していた。</span><ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Anakin's Lightsaber</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>A lightsaber made by Anakin Skywalker. Obi-Wan kept it in order to hand it over to Luke.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>Deploy without spending Force on a Skywalker with ability &gt; 3. Add 1 to Force drains at the location where the character is. Use without spending Force. Target a character. Draw two destiny. If total destiny &gt; ability, the character is hit and the target's forfeit becomes 0.</blockquote>

The Japanese printing states the Force-drain bonus and the free weapon use in separate sentences. The original English printing joins those options with "OR" after "you may then use as follows". That explicit choice is absent from the Japanese wording. Both printed faces target a character, compare the two destiny draws with ability, and reduce the hit target's forfeit to 0.<ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Hoth-L-anakinslightsaber-decipher-archive.gif|Original English card face]].</ref>

== Statistics ==
The printed destiny is 1. The subtype reads <span lang="ja">個人用武器</span> (character weapon), and one asterisk marks the title. Deployment and use are free under the printed game text; no numerical deploy or forfeit statistic is printed.<ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
